body:
## What to build

Keep contextual-share dependency refusals valid when a visibly written base list2env call replaces the environment binding used by a later reflective lookup. ADRs 0010/0017 require a self-contained source and reject ordinary summaries that read an earlier share.

On main `978d7bef4247bf1348af5b90bfab47924db25500`, a literal list2env setter replaces an external environment name with the current summary environment. A subsequent get then reads a preceding ordinary summary, yet that source is accepted for a share. In the reverse direction, an ordinary summary reading the preceding displayed share returns the input payload 100, 300 and 400, while the displayed share is 0.25, 0.75 and 1. Both calls should be refused. Replacing only the setter with assign produces the intended refusals.

The bounded matrix establishes 120 missing refusals and 216 passing controls across three eager input classes, Parent/Total helpers, both dependency directions, fixed/missing partitions and five setter spellings. The literal visible binding replacement is distinct from inferring arbitrary opaque callback effects.

[Exact public reproductions, matrix and cause-isolating controls](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/49e1d16ff42ba33f776e25bc5e895d4296f24371/investigation/2026-11-02-summary-grouping-share-bug-hunt/share/README.md). Report mode exits zero; the refusal assertion exits one. Tested with R 4.6.1 and dplyr 1.2.1. Full bodies/comments of #872, #1045 and #1091 were checked. #1045 repaired parent replacement; #1091/#1133 repaired indirect callee recognition. The new failure includes a direct base-qualified setter. All-state list2env issue/PR searches found no matching report.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Invalidate an external-lookup proof when a visible literal-key list2env mutation replaces the binding that supplies the subsequent lookup environment.
- [ ] Refuse both a share source depending on a preceding ordinary alias and an ordinary summary depending on a preceding share through that path.
- [ ] Cover admitted direct, qualified and resolved setter spellings while preserving actual caller-shadowed ordinary functions.
- [ ] Preserve canonical assign refusals, stable external lookups, unrelated binding mutations and no-share ordinary evaluation.
- [ ] Do not execute caller expressions during planning or extend analysis into arbitrary opaque callback effects.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).
